messages:
teja: quick q — we merged the response change that surfaces `cached_tokens` in /v1/complete usage. want to confirm billing semantics before we ship docs. do we treat cached tokens as billable or only for observability?

sam: i thought billing still counts generated tokens (prompt + completion) but not those served from prefix cache. is that right? :thinking_face:

marta: current implementation in runtime increments `cache_hits` and subtracts `cached_tokens` when populating the usage blob sent to billing, but the API surface returns both for transparency. example:
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_01F8",
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 180,
    "completion_tokens": 220,
    "cached_tokens": 90,
    "total_tokens": 400
  },
  "model": "rw-infer/4.1"
}
```

jon: that example is helpful. two concerns: 1) downstream billing service expects `tokens` only — we can't suddenly send a different sum. 2) SDKs parse `total_tokens` to display costs to customers; we must be explicit which field to use.

teja: proposed contract: API returns all fields (prompt/completion/cached/total) for observability. Billing service uses `billable_tokens = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens - cached_tokens` (server-side calc). SDKs should display an explicit `estimated_billable_tokens` if they want to show cost. does that align w/ legal/pricing?

sam: legal asked that we never under-report billable units in invoices. if we do server-side calc, billing must be authoritative and immutable. SDKs should not compute billing. :lock:

marta: implementation detail — runtime currently emits `total_tokens` = prompt + completion. i can change it to include `cached_tokens` separately and add `billable_tokens` as a top-level usage field to avoid ambiguity. cheaper for clients.

jon: +1 to adding `billable_tokens` explicitly. avoids mismatch if SDKs/third parties miscompute. also add a schema version header `x-rw-usage-schema: 2` to indicate change.

teja: ok. quick backwards-compat note: older clients expect `total_tokens` to equal billed tokens. if we add `billable_tokens` and leave `total_tokens` as pre-change sum, we need to surface deprecation warning in response headers for one quarter.

sam: can we also emit a header `x-rw-billing-source: "server"` so downstream billing consumers ignore client-sent overrides?

marta: sure. plan:
- runtime: populate `usage.billable_tokens` = prompt + completion - cached, keep `usage.total_tokens` = prompt + completion, keep `usage.cached_tokens` for observability.
- control-plane: add `x-rw-usage-schema: 2` and `x-rw-billing-source: server` headers. deprecation cycle for old semantics: 90 days.
- docs/sdk: add `estimated_billable_tokens` mapping to `usage.billable_tokens` and call out caching effect.

jon: code review ping @marta — i can take the control-plane header change if you want me to.

marta: please do. i'll update runtime and tests. i'll also add a unit that validates billable_tokens >= 0 and <= total_tokens.

teja: test matrix we need before release: integration that exercises cached prefix hit + zero-completion case, multi-chunk streaming where cached tokens intermingle, and billing end-to-end to ensure invoice matches billable_tokens header.

ci-bot: build 4821 for branch feature/usage-schema2 started. status will post in-thread.

sam: thanks. i'll update the public changelog blurb and engineering release note. will mention header and 90-day deprecation. :thumbsup:

teja: great. follow-ups: @marta add PR link here, @jon please add header PR. we'll do a coordinated release window next week.

marta: PRs: runtime https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pull/412, control-plane https://git.redwood/infra/control-plane/pull/998. tests added.

jon: header PR: https://git.redwood/infra/control-plane/pull/999 (ready for review).

teja: awesome — marking this resolved for now. if anything blocks billing reconciliation we re-open. :white_check_mark:
